title: Universal script very more features Lumion HUB
features:
Box ESP — draws a box around players and rainbow ESP

Chams ESP — glows players through walls

Names, distance & health bars and Skeleton esp with head dot

Tracers — lines pointing to players

NPC ESP — box and distance for NPCs

Custom colors for enemies, NPCs and tracers

Aimbot

Player aimbot — hold RMB to lock on

AutoFire — auto shoots when crosshair is on target

Visible check and Team check — only targets visible players

FOV circle

Smoothing slider

Aim part selector (Head / Body / leg)

Movement

Infinite jump

Fullbright — removes darkness

Remove fog

Controls

Insert — minimize / open the GUI

PS: Solara and Xeno dont works
